title: Filing the Measurement Report with a Structural Warranty — Repair Estimates & Appointments Warranty Administration
content:
**Rule.** Filing the Repair Estimates & Appointments structural measurement report with an active network structural warranty adds a filing add-on to the measurement charge. The add-on is read from the vehicle's Workmanship Warranties coverage in active status and its plan:

| Active Workmanship Warranties plan on the vehicle | Filing add-on |
|---|---|
| Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty | 40.00 USD |
| Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | 20.00 USD |
| No such active warranty | none |

An active Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty on the vehicle adds 40.00 USD, an active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty adds 20.00 USD, and no such active warranty adds none.

Hypothetical vehicles: an active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty — 20.00 USD; a Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty that was voided — not active, none; an active Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty — not one of the two plans, none.
